known_open: The cuboid receiver is package-private and not registered in production; global War/Diplomacy support, real combined authority tests and production orchestration remain next.
This checkpoint supports cuboid cession plus known political original terms only. Mixed military/territory and foundation chunk receivers are not enabled.
War and diplomacy outcome providers are explicit test doubles; only the cuboid file/SQLite authority is real in the new receiver matrix.
Each pending treaty reserves one MiB of encoded proof text. The bound manifest must also prove that every future terminal proof fits that limit; large envelopes/scopes may be rejected before binding.
Receiver proof terminalAt follows the permanent diplomacy decision time; it is not a wall-clock timestamp of the local cuboid commit.
Cuboid owner UUID and separate nation affiliation retain their previous meanings; retained delegated members and subregion images are unchanged by ownership transfer.
Foundation cession, siege receiver, lease/reparation/tribute/loan money, legacy military restriction migration and permissioned lifting remain open.
Navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel, other module authorization/thread/lifecycle paths and archival remain open.
Full clean Core build, new artifacts, final Core plus Supply regression, SQL multiprocess/MySQL and user-deferred Paper/Folia acceptance remain open.
